subject: social_science

concepts.title: Geographical Location and Latitudinal-Longitudinal Extent
concepts.definition: The geographical placement of mainland India across the Northern and Eastern Hemispheres, bounded by specific parallels and meridians.
concepts.formula: latitudes: 8.4 N to 37.6 N, longitudes: 68.7 E to 97.4 E
concepts.key_idea: India lies entirely in the northern hemisphere with its central region bisected by the Tropic of Cancer.
question_patterns: What is the latitudinal and longitudinal extent of mainland India?
Which parallel of latitude divides India into nearly equal halves?
Identify the hemispheres in which India is situated.
Specify the location of Andaman and Lakshadweep island groups.
Name the southernmost point of the Indian Union and its status.

solution_steps.explain: Mainland extends from 8 degrees 4 minutes North to 37 degrees 6 minutes North.
Mainland spans longitudes from 68 degrees 7 minutes East to 97 degrees 25 minutes East.
Tropic of Cancer at 23 degrees 30 minutes North splits the country into equal upper and lower parts.

concepts.title: Calculation of Land Area relative to World Total
concepts.definition: Determining the total land mass area of a territory given the global geographical area and percentage contribution.
concepts.key_idea: India occupies 3.28 million square kilometers, constituting 2.4 percent of total global land mass.
question_patterns: Calculate India's land area given total global land area and percentage share.
Find the national geographical extent from world land mass data.
Compute the land mass area of India using percentage proportion.
Determine the square kilometers of Indian territory relative to global total.
What is the geographical surface area of India based on world total?

solution_steps.action: calculate national area from global total
solution_steps.explain: Multiply world area by the percentage share and divide by 100 to calculate country area.

concepts.title: Calculation of Local Time Lag from Longitudinal Difference
concepts.definition: Computing time differences across regions based on longitudinal separation, taking 4 minutes per degree of rotation.
concepts.key_idea: Every 1 degree of longitudinal movement creates a 4-minute shift in local solar time.
question_patterns: Calculate the time difference between eastern and western extremities of India.
Compute the time lag between Gujarat and Arunachal Pradesh based on longitudinal difference.
Determine the time gap in hours across a given longitudinal span.
Find how many hours of time lag occur across 30 degrees longitude.
How much time difference exists between two points with a given longitudinal difference?

solution_steps.action: convert longitudinal degrees to time in minutes
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the longitudinal difference in degrees by 4 minutes per degree.
Divide total minutes by 60 to calculate time difference in hours.

concepts.title: Calculation of Reduced Distance via Suez Canal
concepts.definition: Calculating remaining maritime transport distance following shortcut trade route openings.
concepts.key_idea: Opening of the artificial waterway reduced the sea transit route length between Europe and India.
question_patterns: Calculate the new sea route distance to Europe after the opening of Suez Canal.
Find the remaining distance between India and Europe given distance saved.
Compute the reduced maritime distance following canal opening.
Determine the updated journey distance when 7000 km is saved.
How much is the revised shipping distance between India and European ports?

solution_steps.action: subtract distance saved from original distance
solution_steps.explain: Subtract saved route distance from total historical route length.

concepts.title: Strategic Location and Cultural Exchange in World Trade
concepts.definition: The ocean-centric positioning of the Indian landmass that connects east-west maritime trade and historical overland routes.
concepts.key_idea: Central location in South Asia enabled merchant ships and overland travellers to spread Indian culture and goods globally.
question_patterns: Explain the significance of India's central location at the head of the Indian Ocean.
How did mountain passes contribute to ancient trade and cultural exchanges?
Which Indian ideas and goods spread to other countries through ancient land routes?
Analyze the impact of West Asian architecture and Greek art on Indian culture.
Why is the Indian Ocean named after India?

solution_steps.explain: Deccan peninsula projects into the ocean, linking western coasts with West Asia/Europe and eastern coasts with Southeast Asia.
Passes through northern mountains facilitated movement of goods, numerical systems, and literary epics.

concepts.title: Political Division and Land Frontiers with Neighboring States
concepts.definition: The political categorization of the nation into internal federated units and land border shares with surrounding countries.
concepts.key_idea: India features 28 states and 8 union territories, sharing overland boundaries with seven adjacent nations.
question_patterns: List the countries that share land borders with India in different directions.
Which Indian states share frontiers with Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh?
Identify the total number of states and Union Territories in modern India.
Distinguish between provinces and princely states prior to 1947.
Name the landlocked states that do not share international borders or coastlines.

solution_steps.explain: Land borders are shared with Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.
India consists of 28 states and 8 Union Territories.

concepts.title: Maritime Neighbors and Strait Separations
concepts.definition: Island nations situated across southern seas and narrow marine channels separating them from India.
concepts.key_idea: Sri Lanka and Maldives are island neighbors, separated by defined straits and gulf waters.
question_patterns: Name the southern island neighbors of India across the ocean.
Which body of water separates Sri Lanka from India?
Where are the Maldives Islands situated relative to Lakshadweep?
Identify the strait and gulf forming a narrow sea channel between India and Sri Lanka.
Describe India's oceanic borders to the south.

solution_steps.explain: Sri Lanka and Maldives lie to the south in the Indian Ocean.
Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar separate Sri Lanka from India.
